goal: Put things in order by size - from the biggest to the smallest and back - and see why order matters: a tower stands only in order, a choir and a water-glass xylophone sound right only in order.
cover: Beaver taps a row of four water glasses, from the fullest to the emptiest, with a spoon, while Bunny dances beside him on a forest glade at evening, paper lanterns glowing over a little log stage.
